Dividing the utility bills. The five people in a shared house have been splitting gas, water, and electricity in a way that was agreed when only three of them lived there. - The last twelve utility statements

- Trial run of a reconciliation template

Name: Victoria
Age: 37
Gender: female
Personality: Victoria is a calm and rational person, but at times her excessive thoughtfulness can create barriers between her and those around her. Age: 17
Gender: female

Gender: male

Age: 38
Gender: male

Age: 10
Gender: male
